title: Dat 定理 2.2：$Z^1$ 是约化平坦局部完全交
original: The affine scheme Z^1(W_F/P, G-hat) is a reduced flat local complete intersection of dimension dim G-hat over Z[1/p].
statement: 仿射概形 $Z^1(W_F/P,\hat G)$ 在 $\Z[\frac1p]$ 上约化、平坦、局部完全交，维数为 $\dim\hat G$。
statement_en: The affine scheme Z^1(W_F/P, G-hat) is a reduced flat local complete intersection of dimension dim G-hat over Z[1/p].
lean_candidate:
theorem Z1_reduced_flat_lci (F : LocalField) (G : ReductiveGroup F) :
  IsReduced (Z1 F G) ∧ Flat (Z_p F) (Z1 F G) ∧
  IsLocalCompleteIntersection (Z1 F G) ∧
  ringKrullDim (Z1 F G) = ringKrullDim (G.hat) := by sorry
gap: 缺「仿射概形 $Z^1$ 的显式表示」「局部完全交在 Mathlib 中的判据」「$\hat G$ 维数与 $\Z[1/p]$-概形维数的桥接」三块；状态 g（gap）。
dependency: A1 链第 2 块；下游 A2 命题 3.7、A4 猜想 1.4.3

title: Zhu 猜想 3.14：参数叠上的高阶凝聚上同调消失
statement_en: For every i >= 1, the i-th Gamma-equivariant coherent cohomology of the stack of cuspidal Langlands parameters vanishes.
lean_candidate:
def LocCohomologyVanishing : Prop :=
  ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → cohomology (LocStack C G F ι) i = 0
gap: 需「导出形式叠上的凝聚层上同调」与「群 $\Gamma$-等变上同调」两套语言的桥接；Mathlib 无导出代数几何层。
dependency: A2 链第 4 块；若成立则整体参数叠的函数环等于经典参数环

title: Fargues–Scholze 定理 2.11：$\Bun_G$ 是 Artin $v$-叠
original: The v-stack Bun_G is an Artin v-stack: the diagonal is representable in locally spatial diamonds, and it is l-cohomologically smooth.
statement: $v$-叠 $\Bun_G$ 是 Artin $v$-叠：其对角在局部空间钻石中可表，且为 $\ell$-上同调光滑。
statement_en: The v-stack Bun_G is an Artin v-stack with diagonal representable in locally spatial diamonds, and it is l-cohomologically smooth.
lean_candidate:
theorem BunG_is_artin_vstack (G : ReductiveGroup) :
  IsArtinVStack (BunG G) ∧ RepresentableDiagonal (BunG G) ∧
  IsLCohomologicallySmooth (BunG G) := by sorry
gap: 需「钻石」「$v$-拓扑」「局部空间」的完整形式化；Mathlib 无此框架。
dependency: A3 链第 2 块；支撑定理 3.2–3.5 与猜想 6.2

title: A5 定理 3.2：$D(\mathrm{GL}_n(F))$ 全嵌入 $\mathrm{QC}^!(\mathcal L)$
original: There is a full embedding D(GL_n(F)) -> QC^!(L_{F,GL_n}).

theorem GLn_full_embedding (n : ℕ) (F : LocalField) :
  FullEmbedding (D (GL n F)) (QCShriek (L F (GL n))) := sorry

dependency: A5 链第 3 块；A5 定理 3.5 在局部化后升级为等价

statement_en: The derived Hecke algebra action and the derived deformation ring action on the cohomology of the local system are compatible.
